tasks.extra: Self-manage this repo end to end. Beyond the playbook: review every open PR (comment, approve, or request changes with reasons), reply to new issue/PR comments and unresolved review threads, and fulfill actionable requests from maintainers. Coding agent chain: opencode first (local opencode binary is v2); fall back to cursor, then claude, then grok if opencode is unavailable. Never auto-merge release-please PRs. Manager does not implement on main; children open PRs. After the run, send the changes.md summary via Telegram using this machine's Telegram credentials.
